tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an order from Office of the Superintendent, CGST Range- 1, Division A, Jaipur imposing a demand of IGST amounting Rs. 3,28,030/- under Section 74(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 for the period 2018-19 along with the interest under Section 50(1) of the CGST Act,2017 and penalty amounting to Rs. 3,28,030/- under Section 122(2)(b) of CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 74 of the CGST Act,2017 and the corresponding provisions of IGST Act, 2017.Based on the Company's assessment and the advice of the tax advisors, the Company filed appeal with department.

tax_litigation.status: Appeal had been filed, Pending for hearing.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company received the Demand Order that the Input Tax Credit (ITC) amounting to Rs. 14,18,138/- claimed by the company in connection with the expenses of IPO of shares, is deemed inadmissible. Based on the Company's assessment and the advice of the tax advisors company filed appeal before the concerned authority.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner State Tax Circle -B, Enforcement Wing-III,Jaipur
tax_litigation.status: Appeal had been filed, Pending for hearing.
